Run the staged spec origination pipeline for one object kind, materializing kind
mappings, identifiers, indexes, builders, and validation evidence from canonical
object-spec DNA.

  Preview a new kind membrane
  zqk.test system spec-origination --ontology mcp_spec
  Materialize the kind, indexes, field keys, and trigger steps
  zqk.test system spec-origination --ontology mcp_spec --dry-run=false --materialize-field-keys --apply-trigger

Usage:
  zqk.test system spec-origination [flags]

Flags:
      --apply-trigger                 Run glossary, instance-builder, and path-cache trigger steps
      --dry-run                       Validate and report the origination plan without writing materialized artifacts (default true)
  -f, --format string                 Output format (table, json, jsonl, yaml, csv, json-rpc, stream, agent-prompt, semantic-link) (default "table")
      --materialize-field-keys        Regenerate pkg/objects/field_keys.go from the current spec plane
      --ontology string               Object kind stem under docs/process/_internal/object_specs
  -o, --output string                 Write output to file
  -q, --quiet                         Suppress non-essential output
      --skip-finalize-validation      Record final spec validation errors without failing the pipeline
      --skip-materialize-spec-index   Do not refresh the materialized spec index
      --timeout duration              Timeout for command execution (0 = auto-calculate)
  -v, --verbose                       Verbose output

Global Flags:
      --allow-degraded   Allow scheduler-dependent commands to run when scheduler daemon is not running
